protocol.probes: all original 30 House01 probes; original four-cell mean readout at z=0.20 m
protocol.full_TRAIN_query: all 1803 original frames in each of four TRAIN worlds; no interpolation, new transport or DEV-wide query
protocol.independent_unit: physical world; only two TRAIN worlds per source; frames and windows are not new independent realizations
protocol.TRAIN_comparison: two cross-realization folds: train each source r01, evaluate r02; reverse r01/r02; same age/window/clock, no frame-wise split
protocol.models: ordinary nearest source profile, identical TRAIN world access; no M1-dependent selection or threshold tuning
protocol.primary_known_amplitude: squared Euclidean distance in log1p concentration; equal weight per native observation for full sequences, actual-time weighted means; same frozen readout
protocol.unknown_amplitude_sensitivity: ordinary nonnegative gain profile in physical ppm; separate scope, not substituted for primary
protocol.profile_gain_formula: a=max(0, dot(y,mu)/dot(mu,mu)); score=norm(y-a*mu)^2; zero template remains zero; no source-strength guarantee
protocol.order_controls: unordered_joint sorts paired values lexicographically, preserving instantaneous paired multiset and discarding time order; sorted_marginals sorts each side independently
protocol.order_control_limitation: nearest-profile tests are finite-model diagnostics, not proof of absence of information in the underlying probability law
protocol.equal_scalar_budget: single uses N original time samples; paired uses every second native record up to floor(N/2), at most N scalar readings, same nominal window; report actual end time difference
protocol.single_ambiguity_diagnostic_gate: best of single_L/R full window, mean and 0.1 ppm hit fraction has at most 3/4 strict TRAIN cross-world successes
protocol.dynamic_opportunity_gate: single ambiguity; best static pair means/equal-budget means/hit fractions <=3/4; pair_unordered_joint <=3/4; pair_ordered_full=4/4 and pair_ordered_equal_scalar_budget=4/4 under primary known-amplitude comparison
protocol.spatial_opportunity_gate: single ambiguity; pair_means=4/4 and equal-scalar-budget pair means=4/4 under primary known-amplitude comparison
protocol.candidate_priority: dynamic opportunity first, then spatial opportunity; no selection based on M1 performance
protocol.candidate_tie_break: maximize worst-case signed TRAIN nearest-profile margin, then smallest probe separation, then earliest anchor, then lexicographic probe ranks
protocol.selected_pair_near_source_policy: report both 3D source distances; do not relabel a near-source discriminator as a difficult plume case
protocol.if_no_qualifying_candidate: no new DEV query; publish negative and partial opportunities without lowering gates
protocol.DEV_once_if_candidate_exists: freeze exactly one pair, window, model prototypes and all metrics before reading new DEV responses; each source uses mean of the two TRAIN profiles; old DEV is development, never a new blind test
protocol.M1_audit: preserve 0.04 target, original selection and original negative; mathematical/finite TRAIN diagnostics only; no modified M1 fitting on new DEV
confounders: known-source calibrated response diagnostic, not reference-free deployment
ideal concentration readout, no measured PID/rotor dynamics
